title: Edit Distance
hints: Look at the last characters of both words. If they are equal, what is left to do? If not, what are the three possible last operations?

Let `dp[i][j]` be the distance between the first `i` characters of `word1` and the first `j` of `word2`. Then `dp[i][0] = i`, `dp[0][j] = j`, and `dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]` when the characters match, else `1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])`.
Parallel example: the cheapest way to turn one playlist into another by adding, removing or swapping songs builds up the same table, comparing one song from each list at a time.
